originality.rationale: The two cited primary full texts give general two-colour identities, a zero-tree-packing criterion, a sharp equitable upper bound and an exact proper-colouring value, but none logically yields the complete attainable unrestricted spectrum on all K_{a,b}. Five actual high-recall published-finding corpus semantic searches and three targeted public-literature searches identified no exact equivalent claim; different-invariant SCOPE records were checked for implication, not title similarity. The mathematical distinction is the unrestricted quantified colourings, sharp both endpoints, and interpolation without gaps. Priority risk for unindexed graphic-matroid formulations remains.

value.rationale: Determining the full range of wild numbers is a natural research question in the founding arXiv:2508.06711 and in the recent arXiv:2610.22142 discussion of attainable ranges. The theorem closes that question uniformly for unrestricted two-colour K_{a,b}, not just fixed or equitable colourings, and exhibits a sharp 0/1/2 feasibility phase and a no-gap theorem across arbitrary dimensions; each value corresponds to an actual network-edge two-mode upgrade requirement. This is an exact two-parameter infinite-family classification, not a single numerical recomputation.
